newsitem.title: USA: Centex Corp Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Centex Corp Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

As a result of CXP's recent repurchases of its own stock, its ownership interest in CXP has increased to 51.4 percent from 49 percent. Accordingly, beginning with the quarter ended June 30, 1996, CXP's financial results are consolidated with those of Centex and are reflected in Centex's revenues and operating earnings. In order to facilitate comparisons between years, CXP's operating earnings and the related minority interest in CXP have been reclassified to reflect the total amounts for the year ended March 31, 1996. Had CXP's revenues been consolidated for the year ended March 31, 1996, Centex's consolidated revenues for that year would have increased by $222,594 to $3,325,581.
The First Call Estimate for the fourth quarter and full year were $0.77 and $3,40 per share, respectively.
